description: This file contains the implementation of a PieChartRenderer class for rendering pie charts in the PDFsharp library, including methods for initialization, layout, and drawing of pie charts.

classes.name: PieChartRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering pie charts, including initializing, formatting, and drawing chart components like legend, plot area, data labels, and series.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific info, including chart data, legend, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout positions and sizes for the pie chart, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the pie chart, including legend, walls, plot area border, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific plot area renderer based on the chart type.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes data necessary to draw each series in the pie chart, including styling and points.
